name: Introduction and overview — Scorpene-class Submarine — ship record
title: Introduction and overview — Scorpene-class Submarine
description: Introduction and overview of the Scorpene-class Submarine: What this class is, its role in the fleet, and why it matters in naval history. The French-designed Scorpène — 14+ built for export — is a 1,870-ton diesel-electric attack submarine sold to Chile, Malaysia, India (as the Kalvari class), and Brazil. An optional air-independent propulsion module extends submerged endurance. It is among the most successful submarine exports of the modern era. Baseline facts: French export diesel-electric submarine; 14+ built; India/Chile/Malaysia/Brazil..
